candidate_control.price_behavior: Complete native candidates are synthesized before economy lookup. Missing-price candidates are skipped with evidence; present prices participate only in the ordinary Bellman comparison.

automatic_fracture: The carrier has an exact satisfying goal-slot affix selected as the fracture carrier.
Direct fracture is used only when the carrier is ready and Fracture is legal; otherwise a finite approved exact renewal preparation is required.
Every preparation step is supported and legal, reaches the exact carrier, and has an almost-sure retry chain with complete recovery and outer exits.
Influenced, synthesised, or already fractured carriers refuse preparation when the path would be illegal.
The option expands to existing preparation, Fracture, routing, and recovery primitives; isolated hit rate has no selection authority.
permanent_bench: The native bench modifier exactly satisfies a requested group or family/tier slot.
The bench action is legal on the current carrier and its deterministic successor strictly advances that goal slot.
Native group conflict, prefix/suffix capacity, crafted replacement, Multimod, and ordinary bench legality remain authoritative.
temporary_bench_blocker: Setup is one legal ordinary non-metamod bench craft and the follow-up is an existing supported exact single-slot action.
No pre-existing unfractured crafted carrier may be erased by cleanup.
The setup applies exactly and changes the complete follow-up successor kernel relative to follow-up alone through a mod-group conflict, occupied prefix slot, or occupied suffix slot.
The changed kernel advances the relevant goal mask; descriptive blocker roles or isolated hit-rate improvement are insufficient.
Every exit is cleaned through remove_crafted_modifiers, and setup, repeated attempts, recovery, and outer exits are complete and almost-sure.
protected_side_and_metamod: A requested goal carrier is already satisfied on the protected side and an unsatisfied goal remains on the opposite side.
The existing prefix-lock or suffix-lock bench setup is legal, absent on entry, and the follow-up action's native transition facts say that it respects that protection.

The protected exact kernel differs from the unprotected kernel, advances the relevant target, and every exit removes or replaces the temporary lock with complete setup, reapplication, recovery, and routing.
Fossil and Essence are never protected candidates because their S8.2 transition facts ignore metamods; fractures remain independently preserved.
Scour uses the existing exact S7 protected-side contract, and nonconflicting distinct permanent goal benches may form the existing exact Multimod finish.

analytic_price_flips.derivation: Raw Exalt has expected cost 15. Blocker option cost is blocker + Exalt 10 + cleanup 1.
analytic_price_flips.neutral_control: A bench setup with an identical successor kernel is rejected as exact_successor_kernel_neutral.

analytic_price_flips.derivation: Protected Scour route costs prefix lock + Scour 1 + target bench 3; the complete Restart, Alchemy, and deterministic finishing route costs 27.
Complete non-fracture route D is Restart 20 + Alchemy 5 + goal bench 100 = 125. Fracture route Q is fracture price + 0.25*Chaos 30 + 0.75*D = fracture price + 101.25.

controlled_comparisons.temporary_blocker: Disabling preservation-control pruning produced the identical value and start policy at blocker price 2.
controlled_comparisons.fracture: The automatically generated Fracture preparation value matched a manually enumerated S7 FracturePrepare option within 1e-12 at fracture price 23.
controlled_comparisons.permanent_bench: A real Vaal Regalia WASM solve with an explicit Restart envelope automatically added, selected, compiled, and executed the exact ColdResistance goal bench.
controlled_comparisons.unsupported_protection: Synthetic Fossil and Essence descriptors produced no protected candidate; missing cleanup or the required side lock also prevented construction.

intentional_changes.automatic_disabled: No policy, value, state count, compiled graph count, or raw strategy byte change in the three applicable real comparisons.
intentional_changes.automatic_enabled: Goal-matching permanent benches and complete carrier-local fixed options enter the Bellman candidate set. Only a cheaper complete candidate can change policy/value/graph; price ties retain ordinary deterministic ordering and variance tie-breaking.
intentional_changes.historical_temporary_blocker: The frozen S8.0 non-converged capture remains unchanged. S8.3 proves automatic assembly with a bounded analytic native fixture rather than rewriting that historical report.
intentional_changes.review_authority: No S8.1 projection field, role, label, ordering, or solve depth is consumed by candidate generation.

execution_layers.native: Carrier-aware candidate synthesis, exact option kernels, sparse Bellman rows, evidence, and primitive policy compilation.
execution_layers.c_abi: Additive goal JSON controls and additive telemetry JSON; ABI version and structs are unchanged.
execution_layers.python: The Python solver boundary already passes goal and telemetry JSON through the C ABI, so no Python source/schema change was required.
execution_layers.wasm: Release poecraft_engine.wasm rebuilt from the changed native solver; worker solve/compile/simulator paths use the same C ABI JSON.
execution_layers.typescript: Protocol metadata adds the optional automatic_candidates request flag only; no mechanic or eligibility rule is implemented in TypeScript.
execution_layers.simulator: Selected candidates compile into existing bench, currency, Fracture, cleanup, routing, and Restart operations with no opaque macro operation.

acceptance.known_excluded_web_assertion: The archived S7 benchmark corpus artifact-pin assertion still expects pre-B1.4 hashes and fails against the current artifact by design; the corpus was not rewritten.
acceptance.ten_thousand_run_note: No new S8.3 compiled-strategy verification gate was invented. The full native acceptance did execute its pre-existing embedded 10000-run compiler/evaluator/API checks.

preserved_mismatches: Compiler-only mod_count routing remains unsupported by Calculator exact evaluation.
The archived endgame sample remains 0.9942 against 0.995.
The historical temporary-blocker solve remains non-converged.
Protected-reforge captures remain abandoned after long runs.
